supersedes: output-target-inventory-r1.json (kept verbatim as historical input of the r1 review round)
repairScope: X6-SR-03 (P2): the r1 inventory authorized only <RunId>/freeze-manifest.json and omitted every run raw-capture target the Task text requires (command/stdout/stderr/exit/environment/session under <RunId>/). This r2 inventory explicitly authorizes the <RunId>/ directory as the frozen raw-capture root and lists each required capture file with actor/timing/absent/retention rules. Nothing else changed relative to r1.

candidateRunIds.note: candidate only; Codex freeze confirms or re-stamps exactly one RunId; any target below is created only after Codex freeze authorizes it; RunId never reused after any outcome

rawCaptureAuthorization.rule: the ONLY files ever created inside <RunId>/ are freeze-manifest.json (written by Codex freeze) and the six required raw-capture files listed below (written by the ZCode operator session around the one-shot X6 invocation). The freeze-manifest.json entry does NOT implicitly authorize any sibling file: every sibling is authorized here explicitly, item by item. No other file, subdirectory, cleanup or rewrite is authorized under <RunId>/.

requiredFiles.captures: the exact one-shot invocation: full argv of pwsh, the executor path, RunId, FreezeManifestPath, FreezeManifestSha256, CWD, UTC timestamp before launch
the executor's raw stdout stream, byte-faithful, captured during the one-shot run
the executor's raw stderr stream, byte-faithful, captured during the one-shot run
the observed OS exit code of the one-shot executor process and the UTC timestamp when it was observed
environment summary of the operator session (shell, interpreter versions, identity, relevant GIT_* absence) recorded before launch
session identity/trace identifiers (ZCode session, dispatch reference) linking the run to its Handoff and Task records

rawCaptureAuthorization.absentPrecondition: before the X6-AC5 stage begins, the whole <RunId>/ directory (and therefore every file above) must be absent; Codex freeze creates the directory with freeze-manifest.json as its first and only file; the six raw-capture files must each be absent at freeze time
rawCaptureAuthorization.retentionPolicy: all six files plus freeze-manifest.json are preserved verbatim for ANY outcome (pass, fail, partial); never edited, moved, deleted or retried; a failed or partial one-shot keeps whatever subset was already written, and the missing remainder is recorded as absent in the Handoff — never re-created under the same RunId

targets.constraint: single exclusive CreateNew NDJSON stream; must be absent/unignored before run; never overwritten or retried; sibling of this directory is outside any Git repository
targets.statusAtDelivery: NOT_CREATED (path pattern; concrete file depends on frozen RunId)

targets.actor: Codex freeze (directory creation with the manifest as its first file); ZCode operator session (six raw-capture files only, per rawCaptureAuthorization)
targets.timing: X6-AC4 freeze stage (directory + manifest); X6-AC5 one-shot stage (raw captures)
targets.constraint: frozen raw-capture root; must be absent before the freeze stage; contains exactly freeze-manifest.json plus the six explicitly authorized raw-capture files; outside the Task worktree AND the main repository G:/CODEX/New Manga (executor-enforced dual-root, dot-segment and reparse-chain placement checks); never cleaned, rewritten or retried

outside BOTH the Task worktree and the main repository (normalized path check); bound via argv SHA-256; does NOT authorize any sibling file — sibling authorization is explicit in rawCaptureAuthorization
